head_commit.message:
T-2980: deepen canvas drape on two individual covered wagons

Increase reconstructed inter-bow canvas drape from 8–10 mm to 20–28 mm
on the Western Hotel blue/oxide and Wolf Point oak/darkoak wagons.
Preserve their original IDs, finishes, aging, stands, bearings, yokes,
running gear, materials, textures and legacy fallback.

Install the exact previously generated models and update source lineage,
the existing liberty narrative and scope notes. Historical mobile evidence
remains six images from an interrupted run plus a two-image continuation,
with the asynchronous population caveat. Desktop, photographic and LOD
acceptance remain open.

Validation: normal Python 3.11 preflight PASS, 1046 steps / 381 self-tests,
on exact tree 6593357c4e0f98003ff3169392ce4ca5be4b6e9a. Source/product,
identity and placement guards pass; no threshold or assertion changes.
